question: Which letter symbol represents the Semi-arid steppe climate according to Köppen's scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BShw.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **BShw** represents a **hot semi-arid steppe climate** with dry winters according to** Köppen's climate classification system**. 
 
• This means the average temperature of the coldest month is above **18°C (64.4°F),** the annual precipitation is low enough to be classified as dry, and the precipitation during the warmest quarter is less than three times that of the driest winter quarter.
 
• In Barmer, Jodhpur, Nagaur, and Sikar districts of Rajasthan BShw type of climate is found as per Koeppen's climate classification.
 
 
• BShw or Semi Arid-The region comprises the districts of Barmer, Jalore, Jodhpur, Churu, Sikar Jhunjhunu, and Hanumangarh.
 
• Winter is dry and even in summer, there is no sufficient amount of rainfall.
 
 

Koppens Classification__

__
 
• Koeppen’s Classification of Climatic Regions of India is an empirical classification based on mean annual and mean monthly temperature and precipitation data.
 
• Koeppen recognized five major climatic groups, four of them are based on temperature and one on precipitation
 
• BShw (Semi-arid Steppe type) Some rain shadow areas of the Western Ghats, a large part of Rajasthan, and contiguous areas of Haryana, Maharashtra, and Gujarat (annual rainfall 12 to 25 cm).
 
• Maharashtra BShw type of climate consists of Beed, Usmanabad, and Latur District of some portion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__Trewartha climate classification :__

__
 
• The Trewartha climate classification is a climate classification system first published by American geographer Glenn Thomas Trewartha in 1966.
 
• As per Trewartha, there are six major climatic regions of the world.
 
 
• A: Tropical Climate
 
• B: Dry climate
 
• C: Humid Subtropical climate
 
• D: Humid temperate climate
 
• E: Polar climates
 
• H: highlands
 
 

A: Tropical Climate:__

 
• ​​Tropical humid climate with temperature does not fall below 18 degrees centigrade.
 
• It is two types:
 
• ​Am: 
 
 
• Region: Western coastal plains, Maharashtra (Konkan Region), Tripura
 
• Annual rainfall over 250 cm
 
• Annual temperature 27-degree c.
 
• Tropical monsoon type (Am)
 
 
 
• Aw: 
 
 
• Tropical wet and dry Savanna (Aw )
 
• Rainfall 100 cm
 
• Summer rainfall only
 
• Regions: Peninsular Plateau, Maharashtra (Marathwada and Vidharbha), Northeastern.
